synth.title: Join It Up
synth.q: Join the two sentences into one. Use “and”.
synth.s1: Mei Ling has a red bag.
synth.s2: Mei Ling has a blue pencil case.
synth.lead: Mei Ling has a red bag
synth.explain: Use 'and' to join two things that go together.
synth.say: Mei Ling has a red bag. Mei Ling has a blue pencil case.
synth.full: Mei Ling has a red bag and a blue pencil case.

synth.title: Join It Up
synth.q: Join the two sentences into one. Use “but”.
synth.explain: Use 'but' when the second part is a surprise or a problem.
synth.say: I wanted to play outside. It was raining.
synth.full: I wanted to play outside, but it was raining.

synth.title: Join It Up
synth.q: Join the two sentences into one. Use “so”.
synth.s2: He ate a big bowl of noodles.
answers: so he ate a big bowl of noodles
synth.answer: so he ate a big bowl of noodles
synth.explain: Use 'so' to show what happened next because of the first part.
synth.say: Ali was hungry. He ate a big bowl of noodles.
synth.full: Ali was hungry, so he ate a big bowl of noodles.

synth.title: Join It Up
synth.q: Join the two sentences into one. Use “because”.
synth.s2: She got a sticker from her teacher.
answers: because she got a sticker from her teacher
synth.answer: because she got a sticker from her teacher
synth.explain: Use 'because' to give the reason. The reason comes after 'because'.
synth.say: Priya smiled. She got a sticker from her teacher.
synth.full: Priya smiled because she got a sticker from her teacher.

synth.title: Join It Up
synth.q: Join the two sentences into one. Use “and”.
answers: swim and he can ride a bicycle
synth.explain: When the same person does both things, say his name once and join the actions with 'and'.
synth.say: Ben can swim. Ben can ride a bicycle.
synth.full: Ben can swim and ride a bicycle.

synth.title: Join It Up
synth.q: Join the two sentences into one. Use “and”.
synth.explain: Two describing words about the same thing can be joined with 'and'.
synth.say: The kitten is small. The kitten is fluffy.
synth.full: The kitten is small and fluffy.

synth.title: Join It Up
synth.q: Join the two sentences into one. Use “but”.
synth.s2: We did not go to the library.
answers: but we did not go to the library
synth.explain: 'But' joins a 'yes' part and a 'no' part.
synth.say: We went to the playground. We did not go to the library.
synth.full: We went to the playground but not to the library.

synth.title: Join It Up
synth.q: Join the two sentences into one. Use “so”.
answers: so we were late for school
synth.answer: so we were late for school
synth.say: The bus came late. We were late for school.
synth.full: The bus came late, so we were late for school.

synth.title: Join It Up
synth.q: Join the two sentences into one. Use “because”.
synth.s2: We visited her on Chinese New Year.
answers: because we visited her on chinese new year
synth.answer: because we visited her on chinese new year
synth.explain: 'Because' gives the reason why Grandma was happy.
synth.say: Grandma was happy. We visited her on Chinese New Year.
synth.full: Grandma was happy because we visited her on Chinese New Year.

synth.title: Join It Up
synth.q: Join the two sentences into one. Use “or”.
synth.explain: Use 'or' when there is a choice.
synth.say: Do you want an apple? Do you want a banana?
synth.full: Do you want an apple or a banana?

passages.title: Our Class Garden
passages.text: Our class has a small garden. We water the plants ⟦1|evry⟧ day. Last week, a ⟦2|butterfli⟧ landed on our sunflower. All of us ⟦3|was⟧ so happy.
passages.say: Our class has a small garden. We water the plants every day. Last week, a butterfly landed on our sunflower. All of us were so happy.
